commitMessage: fix: IsMax output dtype BOOL in GlobalPoolingLayer and MaskedReductionUtil
notes: All 8 GlobalPoolingMaskingTests now pass. Fix: IsMax C++ op requires BOOL output but 3 callsites passed float arrays via x.ulike(). Changed to Nd4j.createUninitialized(DataType.BOOL, ...) and castTo(inputDtype) for subsequent float math. Files fixed: GlobalPoolingLayer.java:278, MaskedReductionUtil.java:127,283.
